## QA

qa.verdict: This deck feels like someone weaponized intrusive thoughts and then gave them cartoon funding. The best cards—The Ninja Ping-Pong, The Uselessness, The Fourth Wall—work because they turn private brain chaos into public table violence. Some mid-deck OCR gets gloriously feral, but honestly that only improves the dream-logic vibe. Table-ready? Absolutely. This thing doesn’t play games, it causes flashbacks.

urgent: Tighten a few OCR-heavy power lines in late Glitch cards where readability drifts
quickWins: Standardize wording across Komika Axis cards vs standard card naming
Slightly sharpen Falling Boy and Bear Ballet for stronger gameplay punch
niceToHave: Consider clearer stat notation reference for suit labels on page margins

notes: Cover page is decorative only; core deck begins with Suit of Ego and ends with Bonus Artifacts. Several “Komika Axis” cards intentionally lean into surreal fanfic logic and should preserve that cursed energy. This deck has some of the strongest visual comedy in the whole project and thrives when the powers stay brutally simple.
marketingText:
Kayfabizarro: THE BRAIN-FLIPPER PACK – Cards Against Humanity Wearing Jung's Shadow (Free Cut & Play Comic Card Game)

Why does every party game let everyone keep their dignity?

This deck refuses the usual party-game truce. It will not let you stay the clever observer who reads the funny card aloud and keeps their own hands clean. It will not hand you someone else's punchline to point at across the table. It will not let the room off with a polite giggle and a change of subject. Here every card is a symptom you have to wear instead of diagnose: the ego trip, the doom spiral, the revenge fantasy, the full dissociative checkout. You stop describing the glitch and start running it where people can see.

This is Social Story Wrestling in its comedy division: six suits of human malfunction across 60 cut-and-play cards. You draw a symptom, you perform it out loud, and the table rules whether you sold the breakdown or got booed back to baseline.

WHAT'S INSIDE?
- The Brain-Flipper Core Deck: 60 High-Res "Print, Cut & Play" Cards across six suits, featuring THE LION KING, THE JAZZ DANCER, and THE INAPPROPRIATE CLIMB.
- The Freestyle Rules: The complete Anti-Rulebook. No complicated math, just storytelling and the RAF dice ([R] [A] [F]) printed on every card to steer the chaos.
- The Six-Suit Engine: the Suit of Ego, the Suit of Doom, the Suit of Lust, the Suit of Spite, the Suit of Glitch, plus the Meta-Aware Bonus Artifacts for when the table starts narrating its own collapse.

THE "LIVING DECK" PASS (Free Updates)
By grabbing this deck, you aren't just buying a static PDF. You are entering the Protopian Pipeline. All future thematic expansions and topic-specific decks in this cycle are included as FREE updates for you.

WHY "PAY WHAT YOU WANT"?
I make these because naming your worst impulses in the group chat is cowardice, and performing them at a table is the cheapest shadow work on the market. Are you broke? Enter "0" and take it. Play it. Let the shadow have its turn. Want to support the craft? Every dollar goes directly into the time I spend drawing the next cards and refining the mechanics.

Choose your reality. Become an Epistemic Outlaw.
"You don't exorcise the shadow. You give it a turn, then take the chair back."
Stay fluffy. — Uncle FrizzleBob
